parent: Actual b87e852 M13/M65 Git release tree (161 files) as the M115 parent: the milestone that added the shared review-period ruler and the record of which periods were saved. It already ships the plan link on the trade, the checklist rows, the stop decision, M85’s journal acknowledgement and the settings object the two declarations live in, so this milestone adds exactly two FILES and no schema object.

feature.scope: REPORTED completed assertions; literal clocks, saved rows, HTTP and a real DOM only. The count of RECORDED clean reps for the trader’s own account: the three criteria Ep 32 names (plan-aligned, executed cleanly, journalled on the close day) read as recorded facts from the trades the app already stores, its own checklist rows, its own hash-verified journal acknowledgement and its own execution review. TRADES are counted, never calendar days; the start and the target are the trader’s own two settings values (no schema object, no backfill); an unstarted count is `counted:null` and an unreadable read is `unavailable`, never 0. No broker, provider, mental-state, pixel or production proof, and NO causal claim joining a rep to a result (the payload says so). RAW failures/early aborts and DECLARED assumptions stay separate. DECLARED NEGATIVE carried here by name: the inherited M99/M101 reviews cohort is STALE at this HEAD — 157/3 against its committed 159/1 (migration 12/3), because the schema grew after M101 (accounts 26->36 columns and 10 delivered-only tables), which the M108-era evidence did not contain. The three gaps are declared here, not repaired in the probe.

control.note: The mode-aware control probe PASSES on both trees on purpose: it measures the fault (module present or absent, payload key present or absent, card mounted or not, declarations stored or dropped) rather than failing on it.

delegated_runner_exit_codes.note: The delegated runners ASSERT their own committed expectations in their own terms, so several exit 1 on this tree even though every cohort reproduces the counts its own evidence records: run-m108 exits 1 on m105feature/m106feature/m107feature/m108feature (its expected counts predate the schema growth), run-m111 exits 1 on its migration probe (14/2 against its committed expected), and the reviews runner exits 1 on the inherited M99/M101 migration gaps. The counts in this report are read from the summaries those runs WROTE, not from their exit codes; every nonzero exit is named here rather than smoothed over.

regression_parents.method: Actual 9c88e0a M12 Git release as the M13/M65 parent (the milestone these periods sit on), plus the M112 cohort’s and the inherited reviews cohort’s own measured parent maps, inherited unchanged — no parent is re-derived here and no schema or module is read out of an older runner.

controls.parent_tree: the committed b87e852 release: no module, no payload key, no card, both declarations dropped by its settings route (0 keys stored) — four probes 0/1 each, the mode-aware control 13/0
controls.counter_only_tree: the parent plus `src/challenge.js` alone: the count can be computed and is measured working (pure 41/0, migration 18/0) while the payload carries no count (api 1 fail), no page shows it (ui 1 fail) and the settings route still drops both declarations
controls.why: The staged fault is a missing SURFACE around a working counter, not a missing rule: that is why the pure and migration arms pass on the counter-only tree while the api and ui arms fail on the absence the milestone closes.

counter.storage: TWO keys in the existing `users.settings` JSON (`challenge_start`, `challenge_target`) through the existing `PUT /settings`; no table, no column, no index, no trigger, no new endpoint, no backfill
counter.start: the trader’s own declaration, never defaulted onto history; locked (409 `challenge_start_locked`) once any closed trade sits at or after it, because progress is a record and not a dial
counter.target: 1–999, default 21; changing it never changes the count, the run or a single trade’s verdict
counter.unknown_never_zero: unstarted → `counted:null`; unreadable → `unavailable` with `counted:null`, `not_counted.total:null` and no by-criterion block
counter.no_money: no amount, no P&L, no goal figure anywhere on the payload or the card; `outcome_joined:false` with the sentence saying why, and `broker_verified:false`
counter.days: TRADES are counted, never calendar days; `days_with_a_rep` is informational and the payload says skipping days is permitted (so nobody is pushed into a forced trade)
counter.immediately: operationalised as the trade’s own UTC close day, because the app cannot observe human immediacy; the observed gap (median/worst) is reported beside it and the proxy is labelled

scope: M115 the clean-rep count of Ep 32’s exercise: one read-only module (`src/challenge.js`, clean-reps-v1), one read key on the existing analytics payload, one card, and the trader’s own start/target in the settings they already own. Counts RECORDED facts — the plan link, the checklist and stop decision, and M85’s hash-verified acknowledgement on the close day — over closed TRADES, and reports a not-started or unreadable count as unknown rather than zero. Explicitly NOT claimed: money, grades, permissions, caps, guardrail decisions, causality, broker verification, or human immediacy.
